name: Michigan
feeText: Circuit court civil filing fee of $150 (MCL 600.2529(1)(a)) plus the $25 electronic filing system fee for civil actions (MCL 600.1986(1)(a)) = $175. When custody or parenting time of a minor child is to be determined, an extra $80 is due at filing (MCL 600.2529(1)(d)(i)), or $40 if only child support is to be determined (MCL 600.2529(1)(d)(ii)). SCAO Circuit Court Fee and Assessments Table, February 2025.

otherFees.what: Custody or parenting-time fee when custody of a minor child is to be determined (MCL 600.2529(1)(d)(i))
Child support fee when only support of a minor child is to be determined (MCL 600.2529(1)(d)(ii))

residency.text: The plaintiff or defendant must have resided in Michigan for 180 days immediately before filing and, with exceptions in subsection (2), in the county of filing for 10 days (MCL 552.9(1)).

waitingPeriod.text: No proofs or testimony may be taken until 60 days after the complaint is filed; when there are dependent minor children under 18, not until 6 months after filing, which the court may shorten to no less than 60 days for unusual hardship or compelling necessity (MCL 552.9f).

simplified.text: No summary or simplified divorce procedure in the Michigan statutes.

parentingClass.text: No statewide statutory parenting class requirement was found; some circuit courts require one by local practice.
